names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 8 Δεκεμβρίου, «Άγιοι Σωσθένης, Κηφάς, Απολλώς, Τυχικός, Καίσαρ και Επαφρόδιτος οι Απόστολοι εκ των Εβδομήκοντα», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 8. децембар ст. ст., „Свети апостоли Состен, Аполос, Тихик, Епафродит, Онисифор, Кифа и Кесар.“ — with «Свети апостоли» left off and the fourth of the seven bare forenames taken; the see the body gives him is not in the heading and is not the one this folder is displayed under either. `sr-foldpred.mjs` measured the folded string at 0 other holders.

Read out of the calendar’s name link for 30 марта ст. ст., which gives «Апостол от 70-ти Епафродит»; «Апостол от 70-ти» is the rank and is not part of the stored form. The form is the same string the Ohrid Prologue gave this folder in Serbian.

office: Apostle of the Seventy, Bishop of Colophon

feast.note: The source itself calls this day the second memory of the company: its life of them closes «Все эти апостолы мирно преставились к Богу (вторая память 30 марта)». The first is not named on any page read here, and the 30 марта day page is the page that prints him, so that is the day this row keeps. The Ohrid Prologue gave him no second day; the Russian calendar does.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 30 марта ст. ст. — «Апп. Сосфена , Аполлоса , Кифы , Кесаря и Епафродита (I).»

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 8ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Σωσθένης, Κηφάς, Απολλώς, Τυχικός, Καίσαρ και Επαφρόδιτος οι Απόστολοι εκ των Εβδομήκοντα»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 8 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry names all six of its members, so it is one folder per named member and each relates the others. The page gives him Philippi as the field of his apostolic work and the see of Colophon after Sosthenes, so the English form here takes Philippi and the see goes in `office`, Colophon being already carried by two other folders. The corpus keeps an `epaphroditus-of-the-alamanoi` on the Greek 12 October; that is another entry and another man. The one hymn on the page names Tychicus and is his. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 21.12.2025 (8. децембар ст. ст.) — „Свети апостоли Состен, Аполос, Тихик, Епафродит, Онисифор, Кифа и Кесар.“

attestations.note: The fourth name of the day’s enumerated seven; the heading is quoted whole on each of the seven folders; URL year 2025. `types` UNTOUCHED: `apostle` and `bishop` are both held. `dates` UNTOUCHED AND STILL ABSENT. THE BOOK DISAGREES WITH THIS FOLDER’S DISPLAY NAME: it seats him «у Адријанији Памфилијској», in Adrianias of Pamphylia, where this corpus calls him Epaphroditus of Philippi after the Philippians of the epistle. Two sees, two books, NOTHING RENAMED and the disagreement recorded here and in the life; no `locations` key was made on either. NO `related` ROW ADDED: the other five of the Greek six are already here both ways. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.
